jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, ideally in a fast-paced or startup setting Proven success building and scaling complex, data-driven products from zero to launch Experience with AI Agents, autonomous systems, or intelligent decision automation

jobs.title: SecOps Specialist
jobs.description: Requires 4+ years of experience. 4+ years experience working in Incident Response/Cyber Security Operations Center (in-house or outsourced) creating, escalating, and managing security incidents and writing incident reports, or 4+ years in a SecOps or DevSecOps role 3+ years working with security tools including SIEM, analytics & intelligence, intrusion detection, malware detection, data loss protection, and identity & access management Proficient in at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or Node.js) to build security guardrails and automate manual processes

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in Backend and/or Full-Stack development Experience with at least one programming language: Python (Backend) and React/JavaScript (Frontend) Deep knowledge of SaaS software architecture design
